input.description: Local schema file, relative to this config: OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 (JSON/YAML), or GraphQL SDL / introspection JSON.

kind.description: What input is. Default auto: detected from the file name and contents.

output.description: Output directory, relative to this config. Default ./generated.

documents.description: GraphQL only: .graphql operation files or directories. When set, exactly these operations are generated.

scalars.description: GraphQL only: TypeScript type per custom scalar, e.g. { "DateTime": "string" }.

selectionDepth.description: GraphQL only: depth of generated default selection sets. Default 2.
